analysis_method: Re-read the checksum-verified selected M10 Workbench HUNK with the repository ADF reader, then disassembled HUNK0 and the HUNK2 worker with Capstone 5.0.7. This is offline static analysis, not guest execution.

client_message.message_pointer_instruction: 0x016e: LEA 0x2e(A7),A1 passed to Exec PutMsg at 0x0176
client_message.message_bytes_instruction: 0x0140: MOVE.W #0x36,0x40(A7); message starts at A7+0x2e, so length is 54 bytes
client_message.reply_port_instruction: 0x014a: MOVE.L A3,0x3c(A7); A3 was set to current Process+0x5c (pr_MsgPort)

readargs_results.meaning: The three LONG result slots occupy the request tail: NAME, LOCK, UNLOCK. The request remains synchronous while the worker reads these pointers.

replacement.approach: Send reserves fourteen LONGs (56 bytes) on the caller stack and uses explicit APTR byte/word/LONG writes at the captured offsets, transmitting mn_Length=54. It uses the caller process message port, waits and gets the reply, then reads Result/IoErr at offsets 22/26. The ReadArgs lease remains caller-owned across the wait.
replacement.correction: The prior Pack=2 RequestMessage passed host Marshal layout checks but native execution placed ReplyPort at byte 20 rather than 14. The native failure is preserved in artifacts/workbench31-loadresource-protocol-runtime-20260926-v1. That unsupported aggregate layout and the misleading host-only check were replaced by explicit wire writes and actual HUNK transaction fixtures.
replacement.runtime_fixture: LoadResourceProtocolRuntimeSuite executes nineteen supplied-vector client invocations per 68000/68020/68040 image, including two instruction-interleaved callers, stack message offsets, live parser pointers through GetMsg, result/error forwarding and cleanup. These fixtures supply worker replies and do not execute an original guest.
replacement.limits: The production client does not yet locate/start the worker or dispatch resource actions. Supplied vectors do not verify real DOS scheduling, actual message queues, original text parsing or guest parity.

evidence_limits: This audit establishes HUNK offsets and field use, not runtime command results, error precedence, or message ownership under concurrent original Workbench tasks.
No original Workbench guest execution was performed.
